pdf_page_count raises an error when the input is not a PDF

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';
import 'package:xberg/src/xberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    try {
      final result = await XbergBridge.pdfPageCount(File('text/plain.txt').readAsBytesSync());
      stdout.writeln(result);
    } on XbergError catch (error) {
      stderr.writeln('${error.runtimeType}: $error');
    }
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
